webFidoInactive: FIDO2 is not active in the running instance (needs HTTPS and the option enabled and saved).
webFidoLoadError: Could not load the security keys - is the instance running?
webFidoNoKeys: No security key registered yet. Register one on the web panel page /auth/fido/register (link on the panel list).
webPanelAddText: A web panel shows the panel UI in a browser without NSPanel hardware. It is configured like a real panel via its topic; the topic is also its address: http(s)://<host>:<port>/<topic>.
webPanelNoTasmotaMaintain: A web panel has no Tasmota firmware and no TFT display, there is nothing to flash.
webPanelTopicDuplicate: This topic is already used by another panel
webPanelTopicInvalid: Only letters, digits, _, - and / are allowed
webPanelTopicRequired: The topic must not be empty
webPanelTopicReserved: This path is used by the web server itself
chart_script_navigation_hint: Migrated from the old table "Page Chart": this page still gets its navigation from the script (page "%s"). This is deprecated - assign a navigation here and remove the page from the script.
power_script_navigation_hint: Migrated from the old table "Page Power": this page still gets its navigation from the script (page "%s"). This is deprecated - assign a navigation here and remove the page from the script.
panelNoScriptTooltip: The panel is configured in the admin (and by the global script) only. A panel script sent for it is rejected, no script update is offered.
convertScript_noScriptPanel: The panel is set to "Panel uses no script". Remove the check mark in the panel settings, convert the script and set the check mark again afterwards.
panelButtonDialog_modeNoneHintNoScript: The panel uses no script - without an action configured here the button has no function.
